lodging.name: The Green Dragon guest rooms
lodging.notes: Two adjoining rooms. Marge requested a high chair; Homer requested a room near the kitchen. Mind the low ceilings.

lodging.name: Rivendell guest house
lodging.notes: Elrond is hosting. Shoes off indoors. Bart's slingshot stays at reception.

activities.title: Second breakfast with the hobbits
activities.notes: Everyone comes hungry. Homer has already asked about third breakfast.

activities.title: Bag End garden tour
activities.notes: Marge wants gardening tips from Sam. Lisa is bringing a notebook. Homer and Bart are investigating the bakery.

activities.title: Wander the Shire
activities.notes: A day without a timetable. Picnic, pond, and a very small souvenir budget for Bart.

activities.title: Date night at the Prancing Pony
activities.notes: Gandalf is babysitting. No fireworks until the kids are asleep. Book the return pony cart.

activities.title: Journey to Rivendell
activities.notes: Pack lunch and plenty of snacks. Bart has been told that asking about arrival every five minutes will not make the cart faster.

activities.title: Waterfall walk and Elvish poetry
activities.notes: Lisa's first choice. Take the easy garden path with Maggie.

activities.title: Very supervised wooden-sword lesson
activities.notes: Aragorn insists on wooden swords. Marge agrees. Homer must also wear a helmet.

activities.title: Family council: what are we doing tomorrow?
activities.notes: Choose something from Unscheduled. Lisa chairs; Marge has veto power over any route through Mordor.

activities.title: Music under the stars
activities.notes: Lisa is hoping they'll let her sit in on saxophone. Maggie will probably sleep through it.

activities.title: Farewell breakfast and back to Springfield
activities.notes: Check for forgotten luggage, borrowed cloaks, and any rings Bart may have picked up.

activities.title: Scenic eagle ride
activities.notes: Weather dependent, and entirely up to the eagles. Homer wants to know the baggage allowance.

activities.title: Bouldering with Gimli
activities.notes: If the rocks are dry and Gimli is free. Bart wants a challenge; Lisa wants to identify the rocks first. Bring a picnic for the rest of the family.
